# VBF Firmware Files
  
`KR3T-14C088-KH.vbf`  
The main firmware file.  
`JR3T-14C025-JA.vbf`  
The secondary bootloader that is uploaded prior to flashing to run the flash routine.  
  

`bitmaps_preinstall.sh`  
This script was found by opening the `vbf` file in a text editor and looks like the actual script that is run on machine to install the data receieved from the flash via `CAN` 

```
vbf_version = 2.2;

header {
    //**********************************************************
    //*
    //*                  Volvo Car Corporation
    //*
    //*     This file is generated by VBF CONVERT ver. 3.1.7
    //*
    //*                        DO NOT EDIT !
    //*
    //**********************************************************

    // Volvo software part number
       sw_part_number = "KR3T-14C088-KH";

    // Volvo software part type: Jade files, including executables
       sw_part_type = DATA;

    // Network: CAN high speed main network
       network = CAN_HS;

    // main node with ECU description: NON Not Configured ECU MS [0x700]
       ecu_address = 0x720;

    // 11-bit CAN identifiers
       frame_format = CAN_STANDARD;

    // Erase information
    //         start,     length
       erase = {
        { 0x3ffffffc, 0x00000004 },
        { 0x30000000, 0x02000000 }
       };


    // JADE DOWNLOAD FILE SPECIFICATIONS
    // Specify files to be included by adding entries into the following section as:
    // {virtual_lookup_index, "filespec"}, where filespec refers to the PC source file

    // virtual_start_address = 0x30000000
    // files_to_download = {   {0x2001 0001, "..\cfg\vbf\bitmaps_preinstall.sh"},
    //                         {0x1001 0000, "..\make\rel\temp\bitmaps.bin.tar.gz"},
    //                         {0x2001 0001, "..\cfg\vbf\bitmaps_post_download.sh"}
    //                     };
    //
    // Notes: -preinstall.sh starts off a flash erase.
    //        -The binary image is then downloaded into /tmp/flash_image.bin
    //        -post_download.sh uses flash_image.bin to program flash then deletes it.

    // JADE DOWNLOAD VIRTUAL LOOKUP INDEX
    // The index contains 8 hex digits:   0xBAAA FFFF

    // "B"  is a bitmask to indicate file post processing:
    //      - Bit 0 (0x1) set means the file is compressed and must be uncompressed after download
    //      - Bit 1 (0x2) set means the file is a script which must be executed after download
    //      - Bit 2 (0x4) set means the file is an executable (i.e. needs QNX execute permission)

    // "AAA"   is the Archive/Folder ID
    // "FFFF"  is the File ID (For folders/archives, file id = 0x0000)

    // The 7 digit folder/file id, 0xAAAFFFF is resolved to a filespec within Jade EFS via
    // the VBF Lookup Table file,  /etc/vbf_lookup.tbl

    file_checksum = 0xc6a339a8;
}```
